description: This is a PHP acceptance test class for the Accounts module of a SuiteCRM application. It contains test scenarios for viewing, creating, inline editing, and managing child accounts, utilizing Faker for test data generation and acceptance test step classes.

classes.name: AccountsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Accounts module, containing multiple test scenarios for viewing, creating, editing, and managing Account records within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize Faker object and seed data before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewAccountsModule
methods.description: Test scenario for verifying the Accounts module list view is accessible and displays the correct title.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateAccount
methods.description: Test scenario for creating a new Account with generated data and subsequently deleting it.

methods.name: testScenarioInlineEditListView
methods.description: Test scenario for inline editing an Account record directly from the list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateAccountChild
methods.description: Test scenario for creating a child account under an existing account, and then cleaning up by deleting the created records.
